description: A line that will not stay

participation.context: Wrote a start and took it off the page.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You sat at the sheet all afternoon and left it with no new line a reader could see.

title: Scratched out a start

participation.context: Said the bells, the five, and enough.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said at the window that you had heard the bells, and that this was all you knew and all you would say you knew. You stopped at enough.

title: Said the bells were all, and stopped at enough
